entries.204545eba4124db6: A construction company that designs, fabricates and builds three-dimensional structures, bridges, steel frames and steel towers, carries out general construction work, and also operates a real estate business.
entries.3285e0ffafcfae77: Planning, design and construction of general construction works. This includes construction work for factories and logistics facilities.
entries.3fb89295ecf9d76a: Design, fabrication and construction of three-dimensional structures. Research and development also covers high-difficulty three-dimensional frameworks, such as large-span dome buildings and the large roofs of stadiums.
entries.47e2a9b4eb98cfe7: Design, fabrication and construction of bridges. The company also conducts research on bridge technologies, such as steel-concrete composite deck slabs.
entries.900faa0a9889f945: Sales of real estate and the brokerage thereof. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, the real estate business of the company on a standalone basis included real estate sales.
entries.90aa8c7249f551be: This business involves the design, fabrication and construction of three-dimensional structures, bridges, steel frames and steel towers, and the planning, design and construction of general construction works. The company undertakes this business and places part of the work with affiliated companies as orders. Consolidated subsidiaries Sapporo Tomoe Corporation, Tohoku Tomoe Corporation, Tomoe Giken Co., Ltd. and Reiwa Construction Co., Ltd. are also involved in this business. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥27,938 million.
entries.b7b14072d84d2c00: Users of real estate leasing and management
entries.ce5bb31f21ee8df2: Management and leasing of real estate, and the brokerage thereof. It owns office buildings and other properties for rent in Tokyo and other regions.
entries.d00f6efbae1a1c23: This business involves the sale, management and leasing of real estate, and the brokerage of these. The company undertakes this business and entrusts part of the operations to affiliated companies. Consolidated subsidiary Izumi Kosan Co., Ltd. leases real estate. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥7,013 million.
entries.d5a6cea71634d3da: Design, fabrication and construction of steel frames and steel towers. The company also conducts research into rationalizing the structure of transmission line towers and reinforcing and extending the service life of existing towers.
